description.value: A multimodal imaging study of functional, structural, and emotional correlates of impaired insight in cocaine addiction.

Thirty-three cocaine use disorder participants and 20 healthy controls were studied using multimodal imaging; participants provided informed consent and were assessed for cocaine dependence and insight.
